subject.title: Preview session workspace images and unsupported files

question: Should this protected-label PR proceed after the binary preview limit is documented?
rationale: The implementation has no confirmed runtime blocker, but the repository's protected `maintainer` label requires explicit owner handling before merge.

options.title: Fix docs, then review

options.title: Accept current wording
options.body: Explicitly accept the current documentation wording and proceed with owner review despite the ambiguous preview-size boundary.
